findings.location: Definition, first paragraph, sentence after “a complete common facet”
findings.evidence: The clause “with labels on its edges” is a sentence fragment. The intended condition is recoverable, but the current definition text is grammatically incomplete.

findings.location: Definition, reference simplex and coordinate labels
findings.evidence: The definition uses e_1,…,e_d and x̂_i for 1≤i≤d without mapping these labels to the library coordinates {0,…,d−1}. The opened def-function-space and lem-standard-basis-of-f-n define vectors on that zero-based index set and provide e_i only for i<d. The reference simplex is therefore not well-formed under the declared coordinate convention; add an explicit i↦i−1 map or reindex it consistently.
